sections.title: Return of income not to be furnished in certain cases.
sections.text_before_clauses: It shall not be necessary for a non-resident Indian to furnish a return of his income under section 263(1), if—

clauses.text: his total income during the tax year consisted only of investment income or income by way of long-term capital gains or both; and
the tax deductible at source under the provisions of Chapter XIX-B has been deducted from such income.
